# just image things

> Free, open-source browser-based batch image converter, compressor, resizer, renamer, and deterministic test-image generator. Everything runs locally on-device with WebAssembly — no files are ever uploaded.

Live app: https://image.ruxera.com/
Test image generator: https://image.ruxera.com/generate
Complete documentation (full reference, recipes, JSON schemas): https://image.ruxera.com/llms-full.txt
Source code & repository agent guide: https://github.com/irshadnazree/just-image-things

## Documentation

- [Complete LLM & Agent Reference](https://image.ruxera.com/llms-full.txt): Full flag reference, presets, format matrix, JSON report schemas, WebMCP tools, CLI reference, `/generate` guide, and task recipes.
- [Batch Image Converter](https://image.ruxera.com/): Convert, compress, resize, and rename images or entire folder trees locally in WebAssembly.
- [Test Image Generator](https://image.ruxera.com/generate): Generate deterministic test images by dimensions, colour complexity, seed, format, and target file size.
- [GitHub Repository & AGENTS.md](https://github.com/irshadnazree/just-image-things): Source code, headless CLI runner, and contributor guide.

## Use with a browser agent (recommended, zero UI clicking)

Do not click through settings controls. Pass settings in the URL or to `justImageThings.run()`, attach local files to `input#jit-files`, and run one call:

1. Open `https://image.ruxera.com/?f=webp&q=75&long-edge=1600` (URL flags apply for this visit only; saved user preferences are untouched).
2. Upload local file paths to `input#jit-files` using your browser tool's file-upload action.
3. Evaluate `await window.justImageThings.run()` (or pass flags directly: `await window.justImageThings.run("-f webp -q 75 --long-edge 1600", { save: "zip" })`).
4. Read the returned JSON `RunReport` (output paths, formats, dimensions, byte sizes, `keptOriginal`, errors) and collect the downloaded files from your browser tool's download folder.

- Default download mode: individual file downloads for 10 or fewer files (`save: "files"`), or a single archive for more than 10 files (`save: "zip"`). Override with `run(flags, { save: "files" | "zip", clear: true })`.
- Other page API methods: `justImageThings.configure(flags)`, `justImageThings.files()`, `justImageThings.settings()`, `justImageThings.clear()`, `justImageThings.help`.
- WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext`): browsers supporting WebMCP automatically expose `convert_images` (`{ flags?, save? }`) and `list_queued_images` (`{}`).

## Use from the command line (no browser tool needed)

From a clone of the repository (requires Bun and any Chromium-based browser):

```sh
bun run agent <folder-or-files...> -f webp -q 75 --long-edge 2048 --json
```

- Originals are never modified. Output defaults to `<folder>_processed` (or `-o <dir>`), keeping subfolder structure (`--flat` to flatten).
- Use `--dry-run --json` first to inspect matched files and resolved settings.
- Machine-readable JSON report goes to `stdout`; progress logs go to `stderr`.
- Exit codes: `0` all succeeded, `1` partial failure, `2` usage or setup error.

## Key capabilities & shared flags

All settings use one vocabulary across the CLI (`--long-edge 1600`), URL params (`?long-edge=1600`), and `window.justImageThings`:

- Formats (`-f` / `--format`): `webp` (default), `avif`, `jpeg` (`jpg`), `png`, `jxl` (`jpegxl`), `gif`, `tiff` (`tif`), `bmp`, `ico`, `qoi`, `original` (`keep`; HEIC→JPEG, SVG→PNG).
- Presets (`-p` / `--preset`): `web` (WebP, 2048px long edge), `compress` (keep format), `heic-jpeg` (JPEG q=90), `avif`, `favicon` (multi-size ICO 16–256px).
- Compression: `-q` / `--quality` `0–100` (defaults: jpeg 82, webp 80, avif 60, jxl 75), `--lossless` (webp, avif, jxl), `--effort` (png 0–6, webp 0–6, avif 0–10, jxl 1–9), `--colors` (png 0 or 2–256, gif 2–256), `--background` `#hex` (JPEG alpha fill), `--no-progressive`, `--ico-sizes`, `--force-reencode` (by default, originals are kept if re-encoding is larger).
- Resize (pick one; never upscales without `--upscale`): `--long-edge`, `--max-width`, `--max-height`, `--fit WxH`, `--scale %`, `--resize-method` (`lanczos3`, `mitchell`, `catrom`, `triangle`).
- Rename: `--rename` template without extension using `{name}`, `{n}`, `{n:3}`, `{w}`, `{h}`, `{date}`, `{fmt}`; `--start-at <n>`.
- Metadata & output: EXIF stripped by default (orientation applied automatically); `--keep-exif` (JPEG→JPEG only), `--keep-gps` (requires `--keep-exif`), `--flat`, `--conflict` (`rename` | `overwrite` | `skip`), `--workers <1-64>`.

## Supported formats

- Read (12): JPEG, PNG/APNG, WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, HEIC/HEIF, TIFF, GIF (first frame), BMP, ICO/CUR, QOI, SVG (rasterized at output size).
- Write (10): JPEG (MozJPEG), PNG (OxiPNG), WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO (multi-size), QOI.

## Test image generator (`/generate`)

Open `https://image.ruxera.com/generate` to synthesize deterministic placeholder or QA test images locally:
- Dimensions: 1–8192 px per side (40 MP max), with presets `512×512`, `1280×720`, `1920×1080`, `3840×2160`.
- Complexity (`0–100`: Flat, Gradient, Shapes, Detailed, Noise) and deterministic PRNG seed (`0–2147483647`).
- Optional target file size (KB/MB) — binary searches quality and complexity (up to 14 attempts) to land within ±10%.
- Encodes to all 10 output formats (`webp`, `avif`, `jpeg`, `png`, `jxl`, `gif`, `tiff`, `bmp`, `ico`, `qoi`).
